meta_description:
shivya on September 29, 2026: "Delighted to share that I’ll be the official climate storyteller at the upcoming @bangkokclimateactionweek – from 3-10 October 2026!

During this time, parks, public spaces and event venues across the city of Bangkok will turn into Southeast Asia’s largest climate gathering.

Besides policymakers and climate scientists, BKKCAW will bring together local communities, city leaders, entrepreneurs, youth, civil society to exchange ideas on climate action.

Think art exhibitions, films, talks and workshops on nature and biodiversity, tourism, energy, urban mobility, food systems, climate adaptation, waste management, education and more.

Follow my stories and posts @shivya to join these inspiring climate conversations virtually!

#BKKCAW #bangkokclimateactionweek #Bangkok #climatestoryteller #climateaction".
